title: Word Ladder

contractDetails.constraints: 1–5000 distinct dictionary words. All strings have the same length from 1 to 10 and contain only lowercase English letters. The start and end differ.

statement: Start with beginWord. On each move, change exactly one letter and land on a word in wordList. Return the number of words in a shortest sequence ending at endWord, counting both endpoints. Return zero if no sequence exists.

examples.explanation: One shortest sequence is cat, cot, dot, dog, dig.
Neither available word connects the initial move to the target.

constraints: 1–5000 distinct dictionary words. All strings have the same length from 1 to 10 and contain only lowercase English letters. The start and end differ.
hints: Conceptual: The words form a graph whose edges are single-letter changes.
Directional: Explore the word graph in BFS layers.
Implementation: Generate replacements one position at a time and remove each dictionary word from the unvisited set when it is enqueued.
complexityAnalysis: Expected O(N × 26 × L²) time with hashed string candidates and O(NL) space. N is dictionary size and L is word length.
